//: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\qcardia\llm_devices.json (Windows) or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qcardia/llm_devices.json, or point QCARDIA_LLM_DEVICES at any path. Kept out of the repo so host addresses stay uncommitted. 'This computer' is always offered and does not need an entry here.

devices.label: DGX Spark
devices.note: Reached over an SSH tunnel, so the address and key come from ~/.ssh/config and Ollama can stay bound to localhost on the remote host.

devices.label: Lab workstation
devices.note: Direct HTTP needs the remote Ollama bound beyond localhost (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0) and the port open. patient_data_ok=false keeps DICOM-header disambiguation on the local server even while chat runs here.
